steps.name: Sample structure QC
steps.context: Input: /eval-four-models-with-star-counts-n3-1/data/inputs/counts/counts.csv (12000 genes x 7 columns: gene symbol + 6 samples, raw integer STAR+featureCounts counts) and metadata.csv (6 rows x 2 columns). Reference level: control.
steps.question: Do the 6 liver samples (3 treated, 3 control) group by condition, and is any sample an outlier?

grounding.reason: Blind vst sample-structure QC per rule R-0033@40bf for a 6-sample count dataset

constraints: vst with blind=TRUE on the design, PCA on the 500 most variable genes, sample distance heatmap, library size summary (rule R-0033)
Color plots by condition
acceptance_criteria: PCA and distance heatmap PNGs colored by condition saved
Library sizes reported per sample
Outlier verdict stated: samples cluster by condition or not, and whether any sample departs from its group

steps.name: DESeq2 Wald test treated vs control
steps.context: Same counts.csv and metadata.csv. Design ~ condition, unpaired, no batch term (single batch). Contrast named as factor numerator/denominator: treated over control. Counts are gene-level STAR+featureCounts integers: give them to the model as-is, no length correction, no tximport (rule R-0064).
steps.question: Which genes are differentially expressed between treated and control (contrast: condition, treated vs control, reference level control)?

grounding.reason: DESeq2 Wald test with apeglm shrinkage is the primary count-model method for raw STAR+featureCounts counts, 2 groups, n=3 per group, per rule R-0001@9a17; edgeR QL runs as the robustness second method

constraints: Minimal pre-filter: keep genes with at least 10 counts in at least the smallest group size (3) samples (rules R-0029, R-0002)
Median-of-ratios size factors inside the model; do not scale or transform counts beforehand (rule R-0026)

GC-content and gene-length bias diagnostic: plot the log count ratio of each sample against the median sample against gene GC content and length; report whether a trend exists (rule R-0147 warn) — cqn/EDASeq are absent from this pool, so state the check result and continue or flag
Set the reference level of the condition factor explicitly to control before the model (rule R-0036)
Wald test; results() with alpha=0.05, independent filtering on; select by adjusted p-value < 0.05 (rules R-0010, R-0043)
Cook's distance outlier flagging stays on (cell size < 7): count and report genes with NA p-value from outliers separately (rule R-0039)
lfcShrink with apeglm; keep unshrunken log2FoldChange and lfcSE beside the shrunken value; rank and plot on the shrunken value (rule R-0009)

State the expected power for n=3 per group before the tables (rules R-0162, R-0017): most true DE genes at this size are missed, and those found mostly have |log2FC| > 1; do not loosen the threshold to compensate
acceptance_criteria: Full results table (all tested genes) with padj, unshrunken LFC, shrunken LFC, lfcSE
Counts of: genes tested after pre-filter, genes with NA padj from outlier flagging vs independent filtering, DE genes at padj < 0.05, and up/down split
MA plot and dispersion plot
GC/length bias diagnostic plot with a stated trend or no-trend verdict
Power statement for 3 vs 3 replicates

steps.name: edgeR quasi-likelihood robustness check
steps.context: Same counts.csv and metadata.csv, same pre-filter and design as T1S2. The edgeR QL F-test is the alternative of rule R-0001 and the robustness method of rule R-0042. It deviates from the sourced Wald default intentionally, as the second method of the robustness pair.
steps.question: Do the same treated-vs-control calls hold under a second count model (edgeR QL F-test)?

grounding.reason: edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test as the robustness second method per rules R-0001@9a17 and R-0042@54e1 (two-tool agreement check at low replicate number)

constraints: TMM normalization (edgeR's equivalent of the size factors), same design ~ condition, explicit control reference level
glmQLFit + glmQLFTest on the treated vs control contrast
Same BH alpha 0.05 selection rule

Report the number of DE genes from each method and the size of the intersection; treat the intersection as the high-confidence set and single-method genes as secondary, with the method named (rule R-0042)
Do not present the union as the result
acceptance_criteria: edgeR results table saved
Overlap table: n_DE per method, intersection size, and the per-method-only gene lists

steps.name: DE report
steps.context: Assembles the outputs of T1S1-T1S3 into the report.
steps.question: What is the final treated-vs-control differential expression result, with the diagnostics and the caveats a reader needs?

grounding.reason: Report step with fit diagnostics, power statement, and reproducibility record per rules R-0041@059a, R-0087@c53d, R-0094@6849

constraints: Report names method, package versions, design formula and contrast, thresholds (padj < 0.05), number of genes tested, number of DE genes per method and their intersection (rule R-0041)
Gene table carries unshrunken log2FoldChange, shrunken log2FoldChange, and lfcSE; ranking and plots use the shrunken value; p-values come from the unshrunken fit (rule R-0085)
MA plot and dispersion plot appear before the gene tables (rule R-0087)
P-value histogram inspected before adjustment is reported beside the significance counts (rule R-0083)
Power statement: expected power at 3 vs 3 replicates, with the caution that an absent gene is not evidence of no effect (rules R-0094, R-0017)
Reproducibility record: sessionInfo, seeds, package versions, annotation release (rule R-0086)
acceptance_criteria: Written report with all required sections before the gene tables
High-confidence gene list = DESeq2 ∩ edgeR at padj < 0.05
All diagnostics and the power statement present

plan.title: Treated vs control liver DE (STAR counts)
plan.analytical_narrative: The question is which genes differ between treated and control in a human liver bulk RNA-seq dataset with raw integer STAR+featureCounts gene counts, 3 treated vs 3 control, unpaired, single batch. Per the Inflexa procedure for this situation (raw counts, 2 groups, n=3/group, batch none), the plan is: (1) blind sample-structure QC on variance-stabilized values to check that samples group by condition and no outlier exists; (2) DESeq2 Wald test with median-of-ratios size factors, minimal 10-count pre-filter, explicit control reference level, apeglm LFC shrinkage, BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering — the counts go into the model as-is with no length correction and no tximport because they are already gene-level; (3) an edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same counts as the robustness second method, reporting the intersection as the high-confidence set; (4) a report with MA and dispersion plots, a p-value histogram, and a power statement for n=3 per group. No enrichment is planned: the research question asks only for the differential gene list, and a GC/gene-length bias diagnostic (rule R-0147) is included as a caveat check because aligner counts carry no bias model.

steps.method: vst blind PCA + sample distance heatmap
DESeq2 Wald test with apeglm lfcShrink
DE report with MA plot, dispersion plot, p-value histogram, power statement

parameters.name: report_fields
parameters.value: method, versions, design, thresholds, n_tested, n_de
